name: prism-ts
description: Monorepo for Prism - The language where AI meets certainty

scripts.publish:all: turbo run build && pnpm publish -r --access public
scripts.publish:core: turbo run build --filter=@prism-lang/core && pnpm publish --filter @prism-lang/core --access public
scripts.publish:confidence: turbo run build --filter=@prism-lang/confidence && pnpm publish --filter @prism-lang/confidence --access public
scripts.publish:llm: turbo run build --filter=@prism-lang/llm && pnpm publish --filter @prism-lang/llm --access public
scripts.publish:cli: turbo run build --filter=@prism-lang/cli && pnpm publish --filter @prism-lang/cli --access public
scripts.publish:repl: turbo run build --filter=@prism-lang/repl && pnpm publish --filter @prism-lang/repl --access public
